id: title:Gilbert09:treat egress proxy connect timeouts as transient

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion reliability: distinguishes transient proxy timeouts from permanent 407 auth failures, allowing Temporal to retry transient blips without wasting backoff on deterministic failures.
review.reason: Adds a transient, retryable error pattern for TCP-connect timeouts against the egress proxy, distinguishing it from deterministic 407 auth failures. This improves the reliability of ClickHouse warehouse ingestion by allowing recovery from transient network issues while preserving the distinction from permanent authentication failures.
